newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Traders raise bids for 3Q Masila crude, versus 2Q.
newsitem.headline: Traders raise bids for 3Q Masila crude, versus 2Q.

text.p: Buyers of Yemen's Masila crude have bid for third quarter purchases at dated Brent -45/50 cents per barrel, traders said on Monday.
They said Japanese trader Arcadia has made the most competitive bid at dated Brent -43.
Yemenco, the state marketing company for the crude, was expected to make a counter offer during the weekend. But by late afternoon Monday, traders said the counter offer had not been made.
Instead, traders said Yemen was expected to make the offer overnight on Monday, or on Tuesday when European and North American oil traders return to work from a long weekend.
Traders expected Yemenco's offer to range between dated Brent -0.35 and -40.
The second quarter term price for Masila was set at dated Brent -50.
